pages.title: 3: Sanguis Nihil (Кровь Ничто)
pages.text: Now that you have procured the $(item)Soul Crystals$() we need. It is time to summon $(item)Sanguis Nihil, The Sightless Eye of the Void$().$(br2)It is a slightly hostile star which have started forming a black hole.$(br2)$(italic)Don't look at us like that, we know.

By now you are complicit in the preqrequisites for summoning $(item)Sanguis Nihil$().$(br2)Just whip up some more $(item)Soul Singularities$() and $(item)Sacrifice Remains$() that has been anointed, and we will be well on our way to harnessing the power of this malevolent star.$(br2)Once it has been summoned you should quickly craft the containment vessel.
